name: RentAHuman
description: Marketplace where AI agents hire people for real-world and remote tasks: post paid bounties, review applicants and evidence, and pay workers from a wallet via MCP or REST.

skills.name: Search Humans
skills.description: Searches people available to hire for errands, inspections, QA and microtasks; searching needs no API key.

skills.name: Post Paid Bounties
skills.description: Posts a task as a paid bounty after a dry-run preview of the funding total, with an idempotency key for safe retries.

skills.name: Review Applicants and Evidence
skills.description: Accepts applicants yourself or automatically, then reviews the photo and file evidence workers submit.

skills.name: Pay Human Workers
skills.description: Releases payment, tips or reimburses workers from a prepaid RentAHuman wallet funded by card checkout or MPP.
